title: CanonicalScope
description: The 10-element canonical scope binding every mission and authorization is bound to (REQ-SCOPE-001; design §3.1). All ten fields are non-empty strings; company is a checksummed Peruvian RUC, fiscalPeriod is canonical YYYYMM with a real month, and sourceSnapshot is the lowercase hex sha-256 of the frozen source manifest.

company.description: Peruvian RUC — full check-digit validation enforced by the harness (REQ-SCOPE-002)

fiscalPeriod.description: Canonical YYYYMM fiscal period with a real month 01-12 (REQ-SCOPE-003)

sourceSnapshot.description: lowercase hex sha-256 of the frozen source manifest — never a path
